They didn’t know how to structure their arguments, and they spent too much time upfront building up their case with data and facts. By the time they got to their final recommendation, the audience had already tuned out or been distracted by the details.

That’s where the SCR framework comes in.

texts.orig: : When listening to a presentation, say a design review or a strategy proposal, encourage the speaker to present in an SCR flow.
